71895f885463.en: How do I manage a construction project in I-Cost, step by step?

e9680b93b8ba.en: Set up the project with its client, dates, margin and team; import the BOQ and price the estimate; send the client quotation and record the agreed sum; lock the estimate as the budget; ask suppliers for prices and raise purchase orders; log and approve hours; date the programme and track progress; then report on cost, forecast margin and carbon.
